name: APL – Auto-Pickup Locations for WooCommerce
author: Digages

sections.description:
Are you a WooCommerce business with multiple locations, distribution centers, or pickup points? Auto-Pickup Locations is the perfect solution for you. Our plugin automatically assigns the nearest pickup location to your customers at checkout based on their location.

You can easily add and manage pickup locations with contact information, pickup instructions, and email alerts for admins or store staff. Spend less time managing logistics and more time fulfilling orders.

Unlock all features with PRO Version

Why use Auto-Pickup Locations for WooCommerce?

  • Auto-Assign Pickup Location: Automatically selects the nearest pickup location at checkout based on the customer’s location.
  • Let Customers Choose: Turn off auto-assign to allow customers manually select their preferred pickup location.
  • Easy to Set Up and Manage: Add and manage pickup locations right from your WooCommerce dashboard.
  • Show Contact Info & Instructions: Add phone number, address, and pickup instructions for each location.
  • Visible on Order Emails: Display the selected pickup location’s address and instructions in customer and admin order emails.
  • Custom Email Notifications [PRO]: Add specific email addresses per pickup location to receive order alerts.
  • Unlimited Pickup Locations [PRO]: The free version supports up to 5 pickup locations. Upgrade to PRO to add unlimited pickup locations.
  • Import Locations [PRO]: Easily upload multiple pickup locations at once using a CSV file.
  • Export Pickup Locations: Export your pickup location list for backup, migration, or reporting.
  • Premium Support [PRO]: Create support tickets and get fast, prioritized assistance to resolve any issues quickly.

Use Cases

  • Restaurants & Fast Food Chains: Customers can place food orders online and pick them up at the closest branch.
  • Grocery Stores & Supermarkets: Let customers pick up grocery orders from the nearest store.
  • Pharmacies: Allow customers to pick up prescriptions or health products at the closest pharmacy.
  • Retail Fashion Stores: Customers can pick up clothing, shoes, or accessories from the store nearest to them.
  • Electronics Stores: Save shipping headaches and let customers pick up phones, gadgets, or tech accessories at the closest location.

Other Plugins by Digages:

  • Direct Payments for Woocommerce: Direct Payments for WooCommerce makes it easy for WooCommerce store owners to accept payments directly through local and global methods with 0.0% transaction fees. Enable direct payments from your customers via bank transfers, mobile money, crypto and peer-to-peer platforms like Zelle, Venmo, Cash App e.t.c

  • Direct Payments WP: Direct Payments WP is the ultimate plugin for WordPress users who want a simple and flexible way to accept payments. Whether you’re a freelancer, a small business owner, or running a membership site, Direct Payments WP empowers you to accept payments directly using customizable forms, invoices and payment pages.

  • SVG Editor: Upload & Change Colors: SVG Editor adds native support for editing SVG (Scalable Vector Graphics) files directly within your WordPress Media Library. With this plugin, you can easily change the colors of your SVG graphics without needing any external design software.

External API Notice

This plugin optionally connects to an external API to fetch additional plugin listings and improve the general experience. The core functionality of the plugin is fully independent and remains unaffected if the API is not used.

We value user privacy and ensure that no personal or sensitive data is sent to the external API.

Also, we use openstreetmap.org api which helps in getting the most accurate user’s distance from the pickup location.

Here’s a merged and more comprehensive version of the two sections under a unified heading:

External Services

This plugin connects to the following external APIs to enhance functionality, enable licensing, and improve the user experience:

  1. Digages API
  • URL: https://digages.com/dp-api-activate/
  • Purpose: Required for plugin activation, licensing validation, and update checks.

  • Data Sent:

    • Plugin details
    • Site URL
    • Activation status
  1. OpenStreetMap API
  • URL: https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/
  • Purpose: Used to calculate accurate distances between the customer and pickup locations.
  • Data Usage: No personal or sensitive data is sent; the API only processes location-related queries.
  1. Optional Plugin Listing API
  • This plugin may optionally connect to an additional external API to fetch extended plugin listings and enhance the overall experience.
  • Note: Core functionality remains fully operational even if this optional API connection is not used.

We value user privacy and take it seriously. No personal or sensitive information is ever transmitted to any external API beyond what is necessary for the stated functionalities.
sections.installation:
Using The WordPress Dashboard:

  • Go to WordPress Admin > Plugins > Add New Plugin from the left-hand menu.
  • In the search box, type Auto-Pickup Locations for WooCommerce.
  • Click on Install Now when you see the APL- Auto-Pickup Locations for WooCommerce plugin.
  • After installation, click Activate.

Manual Installation:

  • Go to WordPress Admin > Plugins > Add New Plugin from the left-hand menu.
  • Click the Upload Plugin button.
  • Choose auto-pickup-locations.zip from your computer and click Install Now.
  • After installation, click Activate.
sections.faq:
How does the plugin determine the nearest pickup location?

It uses the customer’s GPS to compare distances to your available pickup locations.

Can customers choose a pickup location manually?

Yes! You can disable auto-assignment and let customers choose their preferred pickup location at checkout.

Will the selected pickup location show in the order emails?

Yes. The selected pickup location’s address and instructions will appear in both the customer and admin WooCommerce order emails.

Is there a limit to the number of pickup locations?

The free version allows up to 5 pickup locations. Upgrade to the PRO Version for unlimited locations and additional features.
